detection.statement: depth_l1 grows linearly with the translation of the wave; dividing a measured distance by this slope converts it into 'equivalent cells of wave translation', a resolution-aware way to read a sub-percent agreement. The bore-position reading in the same ladder shows which instrument is sharper.
